extraction_scope: Worker-6 re-adjudicated mechanism claims from PDF methods, results, discussion, and figure captions while preserving limits on exact molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Cc-AFP1 increases A. fumigatus hyphal membrane permeability, supported by propidium iodide uptake at MIC and 2x MIC concentrations.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Cc-AFP1 against Aspergillus fumigatus Af293 hyphae
mechanism_claims.limitations: The assay supports membrane permeability disruption, not a molecular binding target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TEM images show Cc-AFP1-associated ultrastructural damage in A. fumigatus hyphae, including altered cell wall/membrane integrity and cytoplasmic organelle damage.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Cc-AFP1 against Aspergillus fumigatus Af293 hyphae
mechanism_claims.limitations: Morphology supports membrane/cell-surface damage; exact downstream intracellular target remains unresolved by the paper.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Physicochemical and structural predictions describe Cc-AFP1 as cationic, hydrophobic, and alpha-helix/random-coil compatible; these are supporting features rather than direct mechanism evidence.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not promote prediction/server outputs to direct mechanism.

nonblocking_source_limitations.finding: The XML/derived xml_sections artifact is not a reliable focused article-section source for this DOI; the source-reviewed values were therefore taken from the paper PDF text and Research Square article HTML.
The three packet supplementary .bin assets are HTML pages, not local XLSX/DOCX/PDF supplementary data tables; no additional activity or toxicity tables were recoverable from them.

The packet contains one DBAASP linked literature row and zero linked sequence, assay, experiment, or DRAMP activity rows; database curation is therefore limited to DOI/title traceability plus primary-source peptide evidence.
